**Ticket #1234**  
**Issue:** Export button greyed out after clicking "back in the browser" from the CSV export dialog.  
**Date:** Friday, [Insert Date]  
**Description:** The export button was greyed out and remained greyed out after clicking "back in the browser" from the CSV export dialog. A refresh did not resolve the issue, and logging out and back in also did not fix it. The issue occurred only twice, both times on Friday afternoon.
